messages:
Maya: heads up — PR #4523 updates the model-catalog changelog and adds an SDK snippet for the quantized vm-2 variant. planning to ship in next Thu release. need reviewers + a quick green docs preview. cc @Jon @Sasha
Jon: looking now. what's failing in CI? linkcheck or build?
Maya: linkcheck + one codeblock lint error on the python snippet. logs here: https://ci.internal/runs/4523 (private)
ci-bot: docs build failed: linkcheck: 2 broken links (docs/model-catalog.md#vm-2-deprec, docs/sdk/python.md#quantize-example). code-lint: python-snippet PEP8 E501 line too long.
Sasha: I can take the changelog review and the migration blurb. will also verify the timeline note for deprecation.
Olivier: ping — we should expand the migration section. customers need a concrete rollback path if quantized vm-2 causes perf regressions. propose adding a short snippet showing how to pin model version and fallback to vm-1 in the SDK call.
Maya: good call. current snippet only shows the quantized call. will add fallback example and shorten lines for lint.
Lina: I can run the docs-preview after updates. when should we aim to merge? Thu morning deploy window?
Jon: Thu morning SGTM but prefer merge by Wed EOD so staging preview stays up for 12+ hours. also we need @docs-bot to regenerate the release-notes draft.
docs-bot: release-notes draft updated for PR #4523: added deprecation note and migration pointers. preview: https://docs-preview.internal/notes/4523
Maya: updated PR pushed — fixed links, shortened python lines, added fallback snippet to the SDK section, and expanded migration steps (including rollback command).
ci-bot: running docs preview build...
ci-bot: docs build passed. linkcheck: OK. code-lint: OK. HTML preview: https://docs-preview.internal/pr/4523
Sasha: quick readthrough — markdown nit: move the deprecation date to the top of the model-catalog entry. small wording tweak: replace "will be sunset" with "deprecated on".
Maya: done. edited and force-pushed.
Jon: I reviewed the SDK snippet; suggest adding an explicit import and a comment about token limits for the fallback call. small change, non-blocking.
Olivier: approved for changelog/migration content. please include the rollback CLI command in the release notes as Lina suggested earlier.
Lina: preview looks good. I'll merge Wed 18:30 UTC unless someone objects.
Jon: ok with Wed EOD merge. approved. :+1:
Sasha: approved. :shipit:
Maya: thanks everyone — will cut the release-notes PR and tag the release engineer after merge.
Lina: merged 1839991899 by Lina. tagging release-engineer. :tada:
